partition_b_standard_unprovenanced.rationale: Earliest stored dates range from 2025-08-27 to 2025-11-03. Window [2025-01-02, T_completed] completely envelopes existing unprovenanced bars, satisfying the adapter scope invariant without triggering outside-window errors.

partition_b_extended_unprovenanced_nvda.rationale: NVDA has unprovenanced history extending back to 2023-10-27 (769 bars). Derived replacement window must start at 2023-10-27 to prevent fail-closed INCOMPATIBLE_HISTORY_OUTSIDE_REVIEWED_SCOPE error.

derived_replacement_windows.adjustment_basis_consequences: Replacing unprovenanced bars with Alpaca Consolidated Tape SIP split-adjusted bars guarantees 100% uniform SPLIT_ADJUSTED_ONLY basis (dividends unadjusted) across all 500 symbols, eliminating mixed-adjustment anomalies in moving averages.

acceptance_criteria_accounting_closure.ready_definition: Completed session bars, >=252 depth, 100% Alpaca SIP split-adjusted provenance, VCP eligible
